info.title: ManageSys API
info.description: Project management API (monorepo server). Auth is cookie-based: log in via /auth/login, then every request carries the httpOnly access_token cookie. Errors use { error: { code, message } }.

cookieAuth.name: access_token
cookieAuth.description: HttpOnly JWT access cookie set by /auth/login and /auth/register.

post.summary: Create an account (sets auth cookies)
Log in (sets auth cookies)
Rotate the refresh token (single-use) and re-issue the access cookie
Revoke the session and clear cookies
Request a password reset email (always 204 — never reveals if the email exists)
Set a new password with a reset token (signs out every session)
Change my password (requires the current one; keeps this session)

patch.summary: Update my profile (name, avatar, locale, theme, notifyEmail, emailPreferences)

get.summary: Serve an uploaded avatar (public, server-minted UUID names only)
Projects I am a member of

Link two tasks (409 on cycle / duplicate)
